items.title: Left-wing political outsider wins Democratic Senate primary in Michigan
items.description: Abdul El-Sayed, the son of Egyptian immigrants, would be the first Muslim US senator if elected in November.

items.title: Drone carrying explosives found at German airport, police say
items.description: The drone was found near Ukrainian cargo planes before another object collided with a cargo aircraft in mid-air.

items.title: Russia strike kills 21 as Ukraine says it needs more missile interceptors
items.description: The Russia defence ministry said it had struck logistics hubs and supply centres in Kyiv and the surrounding region.

items.title: Why some scientists are thrilled that a SpaceX rocket has crashed into the Moon
items.description: While the collision was an accident, it is a unique scientific gift for planetary geologists that could provide important data for future space missions.

items.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
items.description: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

items.title: Waste workers help winner find binned €1m lottery ticket in Italy
items.description: The player only realised they binned the life-changing ticket after family told them the numbers he played for years had been drawn.

items.title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
items.description: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.

items.title: South Africa plans new rules on ex-leaders' foreign trips after Zuma's visit to India
items.description: Jacob Zuma was pictured with a businessmen allegedly at the heart of a corruption scandal in South Africa

items.title: Pakistan restricts international media reporting
items.description: Anyone working for foreign media, including Pakistanis, will now need permission to report from anywhere outside three major cities.

items.title: Trump says Iran will be 'hit very hard' if Hormuz Strait not open soon as oil prices fall
items.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent both announced talks had progressed to allow shipments to resume.

items.title: Perez Hilton recovering in hospital after reports he self-harmed during livestream
items.description: Miami police told US media outlets the celebrity blogger had been "safely recovered" from his home.

items.title: Nigeria's president orders a 80% salary increase for junior soldiers
items.description: The announcement comes as Nigeria's security forces struggle to contain multiple threats.

items.title: Police raid Starbucks Korea headquarters over 'Tank Day' fiasco
items.description: People have filed complaints against Starbucks for allegedly making light of the deadly Gwangju Uprising.

items.title: Afghan boxer appears in court in connection with death of Scottish woman
items.description: Sharif Ahmadzai, 26, is being held in connection with the death of Elisabeth Ross from Edinburgh.

items.title: Armed man arrested near Trump's golf course ahead of president's visit
items.description: The arrest happened shortly before President Trump was due to host a fundraising dinner at the coastal golf course in California.

items.title: El-Sayed's victory sends tremors through Democratic Party
items.description: His win in Michigan sets up a high-stakes contest in November, testing a left-wing candidate's popularity in a swing state.

items.title: 'My grandmother subjected my baby to female genital mutilation behind my back'
items.description: In Colombia, where FGM is still practised by some members of an indigenous group, a landmark bill banning the practice has been enacted.

items.title: The avalanche that killed a climbing legend - and a generation of record-setting guides
items.description: Their fellow guides say their deaths in Pakistan dealt a devastating blow to Nepal's mountaineering community.

items.title: 'I feel like I dug my own grave': The workers caught in the AI transition
items.description: AI is reshaping the Philippines' outsourcing industry, raising questions over the future of the industry.

items.title: 'I was slut-shamed' - Indian women 'cockroach' protesters doxxed and abused
items.description: Women tell the BBC how they were harassed for participating in the CJP protest and posting about it online.
